title: Final Answer for (a)

title: Final Answer for (b)

title: Key Reasoning for (b)
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between scattering angle and impact parameter must be established accurately.

title: Key Reasoning for (c)
description: Important Criteria: The momentum conservation principle must be applied correctly to derive the scattering results.
